classification: Game-only declared internal exploration current; frozen calibrated neural model unchanged
takeoff_rule: heading at neural onset plus seeded tangent jitter; stream 43; no hand input; reflect at arena boundary; land at current position
round_clock: integer neural ticks; pauses during recorded replay; previous-held command drives interval; impact precedes newly decoded onset at same boundary
change_reason: Declared autonomous walking-port current; no hand access; strike, arena and takeoff unchanged

walking_drive.walk_stop: Stationary Bernoulli initial state; exponential dwell rounded up to 10 ms; seeded inverse CDF with logUnit

ou.rule: Exact 10 ms OU transition; unit Gaussian via Marsaglia polar and fixed 18-term range-reduced logUnit; turning current max(0, +/-OU) during walk; zero during stop

walking_drive.independence: Seed and integer interval only; no geometry, hand, cursor, aim, strike, body, callback or shared environment

measurement.walking: grounded |applied forward speed| >= 0.002 arena units/ms; turn-only intervals reported separately; median speed across walking intervals
measurement.bouts: maximal contiguous walking/nonwalking segments; exclude round-edge censored segments from medians, retain every segment
measurement.coverage: 2-unit square cells centered on lattice (0,0); denominator cells whose centers lie inside circular arena; only centers-in-arena cells counted; grounded positions; at least half means most for this game-design gate
measurement.bot_schedule: warmup 1500 ms, then strike after 1000 ms quiet gap; one type per round, all three types; current position or current held velocity times fall time; no aim noise/delay for bots 1 and 2; project outside aim to arena boundary
measurement.resting_strikes: same protocol as baseline (two five-strike rounds per seed/type); censor if no 200 ms rest before round end; no force-stop
measurement.bot3: existing 10 strategies, unchanged seeds, reaction delay and aim noise; descriptive

selection.passing: All target bounds pass on pooled grid seeds, including bot1/bot2 across equally weighted strike types. Resting swat physical escape >= paired baseline and no censoring. Then validate selected point on 20 seeds, with failures explicit; no replacement or grid expansion.
selection.distance: sum of squared normalized deviations: speed (x-2.25)/.75, walk median (x-1.25)/.75, stop median (x-.9)/.6, walking fraction (x-.55)/.15, coverage (x-1)/.5, bot1 (x-.275)/.075, bot2 (x-.45)/.10; ties lowest forward, then lowest sigma, then grid order
selection.no_pass: Report TARGET_MISSED and no selected production point; preserve all metrics. No silent retuning.

copy.game: The wiring model does not walk on its own. The game adds a declared random drive to the walking neurons (game profile v2.8). Escape comes only from vision through the network.
copy.lab: Lab simulations have no walking drive.
